label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y varón o mujer, cuando fueren en piel de su carne manchas, manchas blancas,
spanish: Y varón o mujer, cuando fuere en piel de su carne manchas blancas, manchas blancas,
grammarChanges: Changed fueren to fuere: the verb is qal imperfect 3ms used existentially and does not take the plural form the draft used.

Applied blancas to the first occurrence of the repeated bright-spot noun as well, using the color word already present in the draft's second occurrence so neither identical noun is left as a bare, unqualified mancha.
